findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Crypto random number generation usage
 * @description Check for proper cryptographic random number generation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/crypto-random-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Check for os.urandom usage - this is cryptographically secure
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("urandom").getACall()
  or
  // Check for secrets module usage - also cryptographically secure
  call = API::moduleImport("secrets").getMember(["choice", "randbelow", "randbits", "token_bytes", "token_hex", "token_urlsafe"]).getACall()
  or
  // Check for random module usage - insecure for crypto
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "randrange", "choice", "choices", "shuffle", "uniform"]).getACall()
select call, "Random number generation call found - check if appropriate for cryptographic use"
